dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems like there's another event going on at the Court of Fontaine! Look at that — roadside signs as far as the eye can see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see what they're for... "Fontaine Fashion Week"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, why don't we go check out some of the shops? Maybe we can pick up some cool new clothes!
